image_description: A close-up view of a Nile crocodile's head and upper body resting on sandy ground. The crocodile's mouth is slightly open, revealing teeth. The skin shows detailed scute patterns. The image appears to be a photograph rather than AI-generated.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible and shows the characteristic broad, triangular shape with a V-shaped snout typical of crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The jaws are visible and several conical teeth can be seen, though the mouth is slightly open rather than fully closed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is visible on the top of the head, though the vertical slit pupil and nictitating membrane are not clearly distinguishable at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are visible at the tip of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows the characteristic armored appearance with scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The scutes are clearly visible and appear to be arranged in rows along the dorsal surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The scutes show the expected coloration and texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface is not visible in this image as the crocodile is lying on its belly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are not visible in this close-up view of the head and upper body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this image.
